en.title: DAA 4.7.4(3)(b)(ii): reserve repos 'with a maturity of 7 or less' - unit missing
en.summary: DAA 4.7.4(3)(b)(ii) lists "repurchase agreements with a maturity of 7 or less". The unit is missing; PMS 9.2(d) uses "7 (seven) days or less".
en.correction: Please read "with a maturity of 7 days or less" (as in PMS 9.2(d)).

quotes.source: AIFC Rules on Providing Money Services (with amendments as of 13 April 2025, which commence on 13 October 2025 and on 13 January 2026)
quotes.text: repurchase agreements with a maturity of 7 (seven) days or less
